# On "Reading Dostoevsky in the John Lewis Café, Welwyn Garden City"

![](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2018/08/jl.jpg)

Making an example of oneself isn’t always easy. Making an example of one’s poetry even less so.

Nevertheless, [I took a stab at explaining](http://ninearchespress.blogspot.com/2018/08/in-conversation-robert-peake.html?view=classic) some of the process behind writing the poem “Reading Dostoevsky in the John Lewis Café, Welwyn Garden City” in a new post on the Nine Arches Press blog. The poem appears toward the end of my new collection, [Cyclone](https://www.robertpeake.com/cyclone).

You can [read the poem, and notes](http://ninearchespress.blogspot.com/2018/08/in-conversation-robert-peake.html?view=classic)–on sincerity, irony, and class–as part of their “in conversation series”.
